about: The ranges a step changed (ADR-0331 §3; exsheet-workbook ticket 08): what an undo or a redo of it selects, as Excel's do, each operation reporting the cells it wrote, the ranges it formatted, or the whole rows and columns it inserted or deleted. An operation on the Sheets themselves reports none. A whole row or column is written as the box it is, A3:XFD4 or B1:D1048576. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' WorkbookStepRangesTests.
